baseline: Gemini editable/exported snapshot before Codex geometry corrections

parking.method: Actual top-face triangles clipped against transformed canonical convex footprints; pavilion diamond corners preserved

pedestrian_centrelines.method: World-inverse segment against every exported building BoxGeometry, threshold .2 model units, no named exceptions

optional_parallel_probes.interpretation: All remaining probes were present in the Gemini snapshot. This is not continuous clearance nor an accessibility certificate.
optional_parallel_probes.comparison: Edge, mesh name/building, probe offset and world centre rounded to 0.0001 model units

georreferencia.json.hash_note: sha256/bytes describe the exact local checkout; use normalized_lf for Windows/Linux comparisons. Git text=auto stores LF.

rutas.json.hash_note: sha256/bytes describe the exact local checkout; use normalized_lf for Windows/Linux comparisons. Git text=auto stores LF.

limitations: No topographic ground truth is inferred from model geometry.
Building centrelines test only BoxGeometry at three heights, with a 0.2-model-unit penetration threshold.
The separate corpus-environment audit uses actual triangles and continuous route capsules, only for explicitly tagged meshes; other old furniture and trees remain outside its scope.

The complete greenhouse enclosure is checked against conservative 3D world boxes of all other building meshes, at every height, including ramps and transparent meshes; this is model separation, not a location survey.
The 1.2-unit lateral probes remain approximate parallel samples rather than continuous clearance or an accessibility certificate.
Field verification remains necessary; no Play upload or application install was performed by this audit.
No es un certificado completo de transitabilidad ni accesibilidad.
Sólo mallas corpusEnvironment=2026-11-17-entorno; se excluye mobiliario antiguo sin etiqueta.
No filtra altura: se compara la proyección física de los triángulos contra el corredor continuo.
El área auxiliar corresponde al mayor triángulo contra el rectángulo, no al área unión del mueble.
corpus_environment_obstacles.method: Actual exported mesh triangles transformed to world XZ; exact segment-to-triangle distance against the continuous 1.8-model-unit corridor with round end caps. Preserved footprints are not exempt.

limitations: Conservative world-axis-aligned boxes can warn about empty corners.
Zero overlap establishes separation against these boxes, not a topographic or accessibility certificate.
Only building meshes are compared; the greenhouse itself is the sole exclusion.
